tenant_application_scope: tenant_id is derived only from the verified OAuth principal and is never SDK input; application_id is token-bound unless the server-authorized tenant-wide application route is used.
public_identifiers: UUID public IDs or scoped natural keys only.

authority_input_rules.tenant_id: forbidden in SDK configuration, headers, query strings and request bodies
authority_input_rules.application_id: allowed only as the canonical /applications/{application_id}/ path selector; never sent as an authority header/query/body override
authority_input_rules.recipient_identifier: tenant-local recipient selector; ownership is enforced by the notification service
authority_input_rules.group_name: validated logical notification group selector; never changes tenant/application authority

transport_controls.tls_verification: cannot be disabled for non-local hosts in the Python reference client
transport_controls.redirects: reference clients reject HTTP redirects to avoid bearer-token forwarding
